agent_notes: The NIRF 2025 Agriculture government listing contains the exact assigned institution and KANPUR NAGAR, Uttar Pradesh.

The official location page identifies the Kanpur headquarters and separately identifies the Etawah engineering campus; the record is for the university headquartered in Kanpur, not a similarly named Etawah-only institution.

Normal TLS retrieval first produced the exact managed-proxy error 'self signed certificate in certificate chain'. curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected NIRF, Bing search, and csauk.ac.in hosts.

The current-linked official programme PDF lists 10 undergraduate, 19 postgraduate and 16 doctoral programmes. The official site also exposes a Post Graduate Diploma, MBA (Agri-Business), and M.Tech programmes outside that PDF; the official engineering page also conflicts with the PDF over Electronics & Communication being B.Sc. versus B.Tech. These unresolved official-source inconsistencies require manual review.

The official New Courses page links a NEP-2020 PDF listing 3-4 month short courses, but it does not label them as active degree, diploma or certificate programmes; they were excluded under the rule excluding short-term or unclassified offerings.
Duration and eligibility were left null unless explicitly stated by an official source.
